 Mr. G. A. Kulkarni - App for State

Coram : Neeraj P. Dhote, J.
 Dated : 08Th October, 2025
Per Court : -
1.
Heard the learned Advocate for the Applicant and the learned APP for the State on the point of interim protection.
Perused the papers on record.

2. Crime No. 0451 of 2025 came to be registered with Kopargaon Police Station, District Ahilyanagar, against the Applicant for the offences punishable under Sections 420, 468 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, on the report lodged by Kiran Sitaram Dange.
Apprehending arrest in the said Crime, the Applicant has filed the present Application.

The case of the Informant, in short, is that the Applicant Dagu Mohan Gudaghe vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/134509520/
1 sold his land situated at Chandekasare, which was under encumbrance with the Bank, and out of the said land, 20 gunthas had already been sold to another person.

entities.text: Applicant Dagu Mohan Gudaghe vs The State Of Maharashtra And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In short, according to the Informant, the Applicant sold the land to him without disclosing these facts.
4. The learned Advocate for the Applicant pointed out that the Applicant had made a complaint with the Police alleging that the Informant was running money lending business and so the false report.
According to the learned Advocate for the Applicant, the amount has been paid to the Informant after withdrawal from the Bank.

Prima facie,
the offence is based on documents.

Considering this aspect, the following order is passed:
 ORDER

[i] In the event of arrest of the Applicant, Dagu Mohan Gudaghe, in connection with Crime No. 0451 of 2025 registered with Kopargaon Police Station, District Ahilyanagar, he be released on bail on his furnishing P.B. of Rs. 30,000/- [Rupees Thirty Thousand], with one or two sureties in the like amount.
[ii] The Applicant shall attend Kopargaon Police Station, District Ahilyanagar, as and when called.
3 916ABA1769.2025.odt [iii] The Applicant shall co-operate with the Investigating Agency.
[iv] The Applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence in any manner, whatsoever.

[v]
Issue notice to the Respondents, returnable after four (4) weeks.
Learned APP waives service of notice for the State.
[NEERAJ P. DHOTE] JUDGE SG Punde Signed by: Sandeep Gulabrao Punde
